title: I-088: Bottom navigation is too web-like for native mobile app
description: The current bottom navigation has four top-level destinations, which is structurally reasonable, but the treatment is blocky, label-only, shadow-heavy, and visually closer to web buttons than Android/iOS app navigation. It should be compact, icon-led, safe-area aware, and clearly active.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile shell uses compact persistent bottom navigation for top-level routes with icons plus labels, clear active state, safe-area padding, and no duplicate top nav on app routes; setup/scorer routes hide or minimize nav appropriately.
close_reason: Mobile app bottom navigation now uses icon-led native tabs with compact safe-area-aware styling and signed-in account access.

title: I-084: Sign in and create account path is not prominent in app home
description: The home copy says users can create an account for sync, but the mobile app-first screen does not provide an obvious sign in/sign up/account CTA. The app over-emphasizes guest play and under-explains the account upgrade path.
acceptance_criteria: Signed-out users have a visible, non-blocking Sign in/Create account action from app home and account/nav surfaces; guest play remains one tap; signed-in users see account-aware status or profile access.
close_reason: Signed-out app dashboard now exposes one Sign in or create account path while preserving guest scoring; login copy matches Clerk sign-in-or-up flow.

title: I-083: App home still reads like marketing instead of returning-user dashboard
description: The app-first home opens with large promotional hero copy and a mock-scoreboard composition. That is acceptable for first-run education, but returning users who have already played should land on a compact dashboard centered on continuing or starting real scoring work.
acceptance_criteria: Guest first-run can still explain instant play, but returning/local-history users see a concise dashboard with resume/recent/start actions above promotional copy; signed-in users see account-aware dashboard treatment.
close_reason: Returning-user app dashboard now shows compact app actions, account/guest status, and real activity counts above sports.

title: I-082: Quick Match setup autofocus hides primary CTA on Android
description: On Android, opening Quick Match setup immediately focuses the Team A input, opens the soft keyboard, shrinks the WebView, and hides the Start Cricket CTA. This makes the first setup screen feel broken and can inject accidental characters during navigation/testing.
acceptance_criteria: Opening Quick Match setup on Android does not automatically open the keyboard; Start Cricket remains visible or reachable without first dismissing the keyboard; inputs still focus normally when tapped.
close_reason: Fixed by removing Quick Match setup autofocus and moving cricket Wicket controls from warning styling to the documented danger variant. Validated with bun run test -- src/designs/design1-mono/scoring/AppOwnedScoringPrompts.test.jsx, bun run type-check, and bun run build.

title: PR 11: Native app shell and flow polish

This parent tracks follow-up work focused on the Capacitor mobile app feel: first-run/returning dashboard, sign-in visibility, bottom navigation, quick setup ergonomics, History/Statistics mobile density, and native back/deep-link behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Android emulator walkthrough feels app-native across launch, play setup, scorer, post-game, history, stats, and account entry; top-level navigation is compact and predictable; account path is visible without blocking guest scoring; no primary action is hidden by keyboard or shell chrome.

title: I-072: Missing authenticated returning-player app route
description: After a user has played a match or logs in, the app needs a distinct returning-player app-entry route instead of showing the same public marketing landing page used by anonymous first-time visitors. The route should preserve continuity into the core app experience, including resume/recent matches, start actions, and account-aware state, while keeping the marketing landing page intentionally reachable as a public route.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated or returning players open a supported app-first route/dashboard instead of the public marketing landing by default; public marketing route remains reachable; native launch, web reload, post-login redirect, and post-match return choose routes deterministically; route contract is documented for PR9 account-menu/auth UI work.
close_reason: Reconciled by merged PR #75 (fix: add returning-player app entry) plus app-entry/dashboard recovery tests and PR10 native route audit evidence.

title: Free-tier launch: usage monitoring + Pro upgrade trigger + broadcast kill-switch
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Launch on Convex FREE; upgrade to Pro reactively (user decision). The free cap returns HTTP errors (no graceful degrade), so two safety rails: (1) dashboard usage alerts at 50/75/90% on function calls, egress, DB bandwidth; pre-authorized one-click Pro upgrade at ~75% (before 90%, never after the cap). (2) Broadcast kill-switch: a remote flag disabling the live push app-wide WITHOUT touching local scoring (localStorage authoritative - scorers keep playing offline-locally; only the public mirror pauses) as the cost backstop. The 12.2 efficiency mechanisms maximize the free runway. Design 12.1, 12.2, 12.6.

title: Abandoned-match reaper + per-sport finalize thresholds (cron)
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Cron every 10 min: by_stale [status=live, lastEventAt<cutoff], take(batch), run the SAME compaction+archive path as manual finalize, flip status final/expired, self-reschedule until drained. PER-SPORT thresholds (a single global value wrongly kills paused cricket): volleyball/TT 2-3h; cricket 12-24h. Feed-hide after 45 min no event (distinct from finalize; resumable). Design 12.3, 12.6.

title: Public Watch Live feed (Phase 1 core)
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Public Watch Live feed (default visibility). COST: de-reactivate - cron-materialized feedSnapshot doc rebuilt every 15-30s (status=live, top <=50 by recency/heat, names+score whitelisted), served by one trivial query; client usePaginatedQuery 20/page. NEVER unbounded reactive collect. MVP nav: NO 6th dock tab - WATCH LIVE rail on DashboardLanding + Watch-live entry atop MonoPlayHub; full feed at /live (MonoWatchFeed) with sport-chip filter + non-dead empty state (Start a match / Browse recent). Design 5.3, 7.2, 12.1, 12.4.

title: Phase-1 exit gate: viewer-scale reactive fan-out load test
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Validate Convex reactive fan-out cost for hundreds of signed-out spectators on a hot rally-every-few-seconds match before promising share-to-any-number. Existential; a Phase-1 exit gate. Design 8, 9.1.

title: Generic scorecard suite (any +N game, incl. custom/silly)
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] StatHeader (leader/margin, lead changes, times tied, largest lead, biggest run, scoring rate), SegmentSummary (auto-bucketed captioned line score), GenericTimeline, RunIndicator, LeaderStrip, DifferentialHero. Manufactures official feel for ANY game from the event stream. Highest-leverage; build first. Design 6.1.
notes: Logic layer DONE: src/models/live/scorecard.js (statHeader, segmentSummary, currentRun, leaderStrip, differential) + 23 tests. Remaining: the React presentational components (StatHeader/SegmentSummary/Timeline/RunIndicator/LeaderStrip/DifferentialHero) rendering these in the Mono design — Wave 2.
close_reason: Generic scorecard suite complete: logic (scorecard.js) + 6 Mono components (StatHeader/SegmentSummary/Timeline/RunIndicator/LeaderStrip/DifferentialHero) + tests. Suite green in the 644 run.

title: Moderation floor (v1, ships with the feed)
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] First-release compliant floor since public is default: server-side profanity/slur filter on exposed strings (team/player names) in create/update mutation (never client-only); signed-out report affordance; youth matches render player names as initials + jersey (COPPA); auto-expire public visibility; rate caps on publish/report. Heavier tools are fast-follow. Design 7.1.

title: Public-by-default visibility + opt-out + LIVE indicator + private share link
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Public-live by DEFAULT. In .mono-scorer-topbar-actions: ambient LIVE-PUBLIC pill (status, green dot) + visibility sheet (Public default/Link-only/Private) + Share (reuse src/mobile/share.js). One-time first-run consent sheet (Your live scores are public; only scores and names shared), persisted localStorage se_live_public_consent=1 - never nag; ambient pill is the standing reminder, opt-out always one tap. Design 1, 7.2, 12.4.

title: Spectator route /live/:token (no sign-in)
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Spectator route /live/:token registered ABOVE :sport/* (/:sport/live/:matchId is taken by LegacyTennisLiveRoute ~index.jsx L1541). Public, no sign-in. MonoWatchMatch: sticky scorebug (useQuery getByToken, never recomputed from log) + serve indicator + completed-sets ledger + live-pulse + 90s stale->PAUSED + kiosk=1. Add /live to GUARD_BYPASS_PREFIXES (~index.jsx L161) so share-link followers are not bounced to onboarding; route renders no dock + leaves scoring back-button guards dormant. Coarse aria-live=polite (set/game score only). Design 5, 12.4.
notes: RESOLVER RESOLVED: public reads (getByToken/getMeta/listEvents/eventsSince) are now all TOKEN-keyed + gated (public+unlisted allowed, private/removed blocked). Spectator uses the token end-to-end; no _id needed. Remaining for 0yr: the React /live/:token route + page composition (scorebug + Feed/Scorecard/Stats tabs) reading these queries.
close_reason: Spectator route + page built + tested (5 tests, 807 suite). Split-query egress-efficient; scorebug always current. Feed-ordering refinement tracked in scoreeasy-bji.

title: useLiveBroadcast hook + wire into all 4 live-score screens
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Hook mirrors each local scoring action to Convex without altering the localStorage-authoritative loop. Wire into generic/sets, tennis, cricket, and tournament live-score screens. Design 5.

title: Offline-first broadcast: se_outbox persisted queue + idempotent reconcile
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] localStorage stays authoritative for the live match. Persisted se_outbox survives app-kill; on Capacitor networkStatusChange replay through upsert-by-idemKey. Optimistic snapshot update with rollback. A failed Convex write must never break local scoring. Design 3.1, 3.4.
close_reason: Implemented + verified in the 777-test green run: offline outbox (21), tennis scorebug+grid (12).

title: Public token-gated queries: getByToken + listEvents (paginated)
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Plain no-auth queries. getByToken: single .get by_token, return validator whitelists ONLY sport,status,scores,serving,timestamps (<=8 scalars,<=300B) - NO names in the hot snapshot. Team/player NAMES come from a SEPARATE rarely-invalidated meta query read once (cost: avoids re-pushing name bytes every point). listEvents=usePaginatedQuery(50/page) by seq; eventsSince(seq) cursor for live tail/reconnect deltas. No enumerate query. Design 4.4, 7.2, 12.2, 12.5.
close_reason: Security-hardened after convex-reviewer audit: token-gating + return validators + bounded reads. 15 convex-tests green.

title: Operator mutations: create/scorePoint/undo/finalize (single-writer, transactional, idempotent)
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] authedMutation set. scorePoint: dedupe on clientEventId, append matchEvents with next seq, AND patch snapshot - one transaction. Undo appends a compensating event. finalize archives into matches reusing clientMatchId. COST: coalesce the SNAPSHOT push to <=1 per 250ms for continuous sports (cricket immediate); NEVER debounce the matchEvents append (replay fidelity). Snapshot field budget <=300B/<=12 scalars. Design 3.3, 3.6, 4.4, 12.2.
close_reason: Implemented + verified in the 741-test green run: backend mutations/queries (12 convex-test), volleyball scorebug+matrix (16).

title: Shared scoring event model with denormalized running totals
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Define matchEvents/scoringEvents shape carrying value (+1/+N), type, and runningA/runningB so every timeline and derived stat is one O(n) pass. Undo is append-compensating, never destructive delete. Powers generic + per-sport scorecards. Design 3.6, 4.2, 6.
close_reason: Implemented + verified: schema typechecks; event model + generic scorecard logic 46 tests green (590 suite).

title: Convex schema: liveMatches snapshot + matchEvents log
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Add liveMatches (tiny snapshot; token unguessable v.string not _id) + matchEvents (append-only log). Indexes: liveMatches by_token, by_feed (status-leading: status,visibility,moderationStatus,feedRank), by_stale (status,lastEventAt); matchEvents by_match_seq (matchId,seq) + by_match_client (matchId,clientEventId) for outbox idempotency. Add token + eventBlobId + eventCount + finalizedReason to matches (archive + token-fallback). Design 4.1-4.2, 12.3, 12.6.
close_reason: Implemented + verified: schema typechecks; event model + generic scorecard logic 46 tests green (590 suite).

title: Live match streaming + mature point-by-point scorecards
description: Two intertwined features: (1) live match broadcast/spectating - every match is PUBLIC-LIVE by default (CricHeroes-style), opt-out to private, plus a private share link; anyone watches a read-only live scoreboard with no sign-in; strict data minimization (only scores + team/player names exposed, enforced by Convex return validators). (2) broadcast-grade point-by-point scorecards across every sport family AND custom games, with a persisted ball-by-ball event log for live commentary + post-match replay. Public-by-default makes the public feed + a moderation floor Phase-1 requirements (Apple 1.2 / COPPA youth-initials). Design: docs/plans/2026-06-22-live-matches-and-scorecard-design.md. Architecture: Convex split-document (liveMatches snapshot + matchEvents log), single-writer transactional mutations, offline-first se_outbox mirror.

title: Spectator feed: newest-first ordering + full-log scorecard tab
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] MonoWatchMatch Feed + Scorecard tabs share one paginated listEvents (asc by seq). For matches >30 events the Feed opens on the OLDEST plays (not the current rally) and the Scorecard tab reflects only the loaded window. The scorebug is always current (snapshot-driven). Fix: a dedicated newest-first (desc) paginated feed query so the feed opens on current plays + loadMore=older; and the Scorecard tab should load ALL events (paginate to done) + sort chronologically (or derive volleyball matrix from snapshot.setScores). Design 5.1, 12.2.

title: Phase-2 nav: merge History+Stats into Matches to free a dock cell for LIVE
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Mobile dock is already 5 cells; a 6th drops below 54px touch target. Phase-2: merge History+Stats into one sub-tabbed Matches destination (both retrospective) -> Home/Play/LIVE/Matches/Account. Touches /history + /statistics routes, redirects, MonoHistory.test/MonoStatistics.test. Design 12.4, 12.6.

title: Guarded matchEvents cleanup sweep + retention (cron)
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Cron every 6h: paginate finalized matches older than 48h, delete each match events in one transaction (single match <16384 rows), re-verify the drop guard first. Keep cold blob for life of match. Non-overlapping runs. Design 12.3, 12.6.

title: Data lifecycle: compaction-on-finalize + drop guard + cold-blob
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] On finalize write compacted scorecard JSON to matches.detail (lossless for low-event sports). High-event sports (cricket ball-by-ball) ALSO gzip the raw ordered log to Convex File Storage (eventBlobId,eventCount,eventSchemaVersion) before any row drop. DROP GUARD: matchEvents deletable only when BOTH the compacted scorecard AND (high-event) the cold blob exist; re-check per match. Design 12.3, 12.6.

title: Heavier moderation (fast-follow): Block/Hide + queue + audit + AUP + appeals
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Phase-2 fast-follow on top of the v1 floor: Block/Hide flows (block enforced both directions), operator review queue + append-only audit, AUP acceptance gate, appeals, rate-limiter component, ML/phonetic near-miss filtering, reserved/verified club names, DSA transparency counts. Design 7.1.

notes: LOGIC DONE + green (goals.js lineScore+goalsState, 8 tests; generic +N for rugby/kabaddi). Remaining: LineScore + Timeline React components + football match-centre (UI).
close_reason: Logic + UI complete, verified in the 802-test green run: goals LineScore/Timeline/Breakdown (9), cricket scorebug + batting/bowling cards (16).

title: Cricket scorecard (additive): deliveries log + cards + commentary
description: [Epic scoreeasy-7ye] Additive over MonoCricketTestLiveScore. Per-ball deliveries log is source of truth; batting card, bowling card, extras, FoW, partnership, RRR, ball-by-ball commentary are pure projections. Integrity invariant: sum(batter runs)+extras == innings.runs every ball. Design 6.5.
notes: LOGIC DONE + green (cricket.js projections, 24 tests). Remaining: cricket scorebug + batting/bowling card React components (UI).
close_reason: Logic + UI complete, verified in the 802-test green run: goals LineScore/Timeline/Breakdown (9), cricket scorebug + batting/bowling cards (16).

notes: LOGIC DONE + green (tennis.js, 37 tests). Remaining: tennis 2-row scorebug + 5-col set grid React components (UI).
close_reason: Implemented + verified in the 777-test green run: offline outbox (21), tennis scorebug+grid (12).

notes: LOGIC DONE: volleyballState (src/models/live/volleyball.js) + 34 tests (rally, no-cap deuce, decider to 15, bo3/bo5, setPoint/matchPoint, sideSwitch at 8, serve-from-events, undo). Remaining: volleyball scorebug + set-by-set matrix React components (UI layer) - next wave.
